items.what: Venue of Afghanistan v Bangladesh 3rd ODI
items.detail: ACB briefing (via Ariana News) says the last two tri-series matches are in Sharjah; ESPNcricinfo's scorecard header says Sharjah while another ESPNcricinfo match page shows Zayed Cricket Stadium, Abu Dhabi. Venue left out of the table rather than guessed.

items.what: Sharjah vs Abu Dhabi for the same fixture
items.detail: Two pages on the same publisher disagree about the ground; recorded as a flag and not resolved by us.

OLBG serves relative labels ('Today', 'Tomorrow') plus a clock time in the viewer's timezone. Cross-checking the same darts fixtures against dated PDC listings shows a 5-hour offset (PDC 18:15 UK rendered by OLBG as 'Tomorrow 13:15'). We therefore print OLBG's label verbatim and do NOT convert; treat every start time as provisional.

items.what: Fixture and format not on the official WST site
items.detail: WST's site confirms the event, venue and date but the per-match order of play used here comes from snooker.org, an independent archive. Flagged rather than presented as official.
Secondary sites gave conflicting head-to-head tallies for Fernandez v Sasnovich, and no official WTA head-to-head page was captured, so no H2H claim is made anywhere.

Every sport page carries a 'Load More Tips' control and lazy-loaded cards. The inventory is the first page of each sport exactly as served at capture, so it is a complete record of what OLBG showed first, not necessarily every fixture OLBG holds.
OLBG's rugby league page served only 2027 outright markets (State of Origin, Super League, NRL) and no upcoming fixtures. Reported as empty rather than padded with invented matches.
Only one MLB game (TB Rays @ MIL Brewers) was listed on the captured page, consistent with the postseason schedule. Not padded.
Greyhound cards turn over every few minutes; the six races recorded here had already expired by the time of publication. They are kept as examples of the capture format, not as live fixtures.
Golf tipsters are listed by OLBG but no golf fixture rows were served on the pages captured; OLBG's golf sport id was not observed and no id is invented.
Motor racing on OLBG is race-winner/futures betting with no head-to-head match lines, so it cannot carry a per-match line. No id observed in this capture.

items.what: Some excluded OLBG ids were not observed
items.detail: Football (1), Horse Racing (2), American Football (11) and Boxing/UFC/MMA (16) ids were confirmed from live pages. Hurling, Cycling and Specials were on the exclusion list but their ids were not observed, so they are left null in data/sports.json instead of guessed.

The PDC pages captured do not publish a per-player results list for van Duijvenbode, so his form is a declared gap rather than an assertion.

items.what: Competition names for tennis, snooker, cricket, darts, handball, volleyball, rugby
items.detail: OLBG's list rows for these sports do not print a competition name (they do for NBA/EuroLeague/EHL etc.). The competition column is left blank on the board instead of being inferred from tournament dates.
